data.title: Israel unlikely to strike Iran without Donald Trump, amid fears Benjamin Netanyahu may act alone | The Jerusalem Post
data.description: A renewed war with Iran could have consequences across the Middle East, the report said, adding that Israel wants to avoid being seen as responsible for triggering a regional war.
